newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA SLIPS IN NERVOUS TRADE DESPITE ISSUE NEWS.
newsitem.headline: HANSA SLIPS IN NERVOUS TRADE DESPITE ISSUE NEWS.

text.p: Hansapank was slipping slightly in early trade on the Estonian bourse on Friday as investors became nervous of the stock's recent rapid rise, dealers said.
The fall in price came despite what dealers said was generally positive news about the bank's new share issue, which will double its share capital.
Hansapank's early morning trade was leading the market with a spread of 230.00/236.00 down on Thursday's close of 238.00 kroons. Volume was more than eught million kroons by 0900 GMT.
"Hansapank's share issue news was positive and the price could have risen on it but the information was already in the market and the whole market is nervous," one dealer said.
The bank has already said it would issue new shares but had not given details of the size of the share issue.
"General selling pressure brought a downward price correction to their stock," said another trader.
